inventory_source_notes.redistribution_status: No independent license grant inferred. Default bundle is programme-authored code/config/compact derived results; original assets require notice/URL-based acquisition when rights are unresolved. Article/source license excerpts are evidence, not a blanket repository license.
portable_rerun_notes: Keep repository-relative layout for __file__-based roots. Preserve input bytes and pinned hashes. Install stated scientific dependencies separately; do not copy original runtime.
New output namespaces are required. Historical immutable run directories must not be overwritten.

Authorization/freeze/runtime source checks remain active in immutable runners. Later guarded studies need an explicitly documented portable launch/config adapter; none was implemented or tested by this inventory.
inventory_source_notes.command_limit: Commands document source CLI, are not tested portable instructions and do not grant execution. Fixed-output early runners need an explicit new output path adaptation; guarded later runners additionally require historical or prospectively reviewed exact auth/freeze/runtime context.

policy: Source/data/model files are acquired from their owners. Only explicitly identified programme transcriptions are bundled. URLs are historical and were not re-fetched during publication preparation.
